answer: Like a fungal mycelium stitching a scattered grove, dune, and meadow into one resilient organism, decentralized trust crystallizes through recursive peer staking. An agent stakes non-transferable reputational collateral on peers validating tasks. When verifying claims, graph-theoretic trust propagates along these weighted hyphae; falsified identities trigger quadratic slashing, creating superlinear attacker cost that scales exponentially with forged presence.
